_note: One set of references, one translation per locale. The references are language independent by design: the model picks a reference, and each locale resolves it in its own version. Adding a language means adding an entry to versions, not touching this list.

pt-BR.note: 129 = NVI (Nova Versao Internacional, Biblica Inc.), granted through the account's Bible licence. All rights reserved, which is why this repo is private. Regenerate against BLT (id 3254, CC BY-SA) before making it public. Note the /bibles?language_ranges[] listing does NOT report 129 for pt even when access works - direct passage access is the authority, not the listing.

en.note: 206 = World English Bible, public domain. Chosen over NIV (111, also served by this key) precisely because it is public domain: English adds no new licence obligation, so it is the locale that could ship publicly first. Verified by direct passage access on NEH.4.6, not by the version listing.

_chapters_note: Every chapter a CITED verse lives in must appear here, or the reader's 'Saber mais' opens an empty chapter and AGENTS.md rule 12 is broken: the citation may be deferred, the access never. The nine-stage season cites in seven chapters, and all seven are packaged. NEH.3 is not a spare entry and never was an accident: six residents take their names from it through npcs.json source_ref, the gate panel's record plate is NEH.3, and ScriptureService.ChapterDisplay('NEH.3') can only print 'Neemias 3' instead of a raw database key because that chapter is packaged - which used to depend on the single verse NEH.3.1 happening to sit in the verses list. Stage 4 now cites five of its verses outright, so the coupling is stated rather than inherited. NEH.12 arrives with stage 9, whose gate panel opens on it. 1CO.13 stays out, and 1CO.13.13 was dropped from verses with it: nothing in Assets/ cites either, and packaging a chapter with no beat attached would ship licensed text the game never shows.
